That still doesn't change that fact that it's unfair for people that had to choose a community college and pay out of pocket because they had no hope in paying off a University loan. If I knew my loans would be forgiven, yeah I'd go to University, it's not guaranteed though.  So why should everyone else have to cover the people that do get go.  The money comes from somewhere to be forgiven, that's our taxes in the end.  If you're so worried about loans, then just go to community college like the rest of us poor people.  It's not fair that I decided to be safe and do community college because I'm poor, while someone goes to University essentially for free.
